props.name: groups
props.description: Row order, top to bottom. Defaults to the order groups first appear.

props.name: valueLabel
props.description: Name of the measure, printed under the axis.

props.name: format
props.description: Format values on the axis and in the tooltip.

props.name: rowHeight
props.description: Height of each row in viewBox pixels.

props.name: showMedian
props.description: Mark each row’s median with a short line.

props.name: selected
props.description: Id of the highlighted point. Omit to let the chart track it.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called when a point is clicked or chosen with Enter; null when the selection is cleared.
